carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin is fully visible and exhibits a dense cluster of smaller, high-luminance spots. A high-contrast linear feature (likely a remora) is positioned near the ventral attachment of the pectoral fin.
